name: HarmonyOS Dev Agent
description: An ArkTS/ArkUI development agent that edits source through base workspace tools and verifies through the HarmonyOS Dev Runtime.

serviceActions.name: understandHarmonyProject
serviceActions.description: Detect the HarmonyOS project, bundle, module, ability, target SDK, signing status, and likely ArkUI source files.

serviceActions.name: reviseHarmonyUi
serviceActions.description: Make scoped ArkTS/ArkUI source edits from user intent and optional selected screen context.

serviceActions.name: buildInstallVerify
serviceActions.description: Build the HarmonyOS project, install and launch when a target is available, then capture screenshot and UI hierarchy evidence.

serviceActions.name: diagnoseHarmonyFailure
serviceActions.description: Use redacted runtime diagnostics, build logs, HDC target state, and project source to explain and repair HarmonyOS failures.

examples.title: Refine selected UI
examples.prompt: Using the selected region in HarmonyOS Dev, make this ArkUI button spacing feel cleaner, then build and verify it.

examples.title: Fix launch failure
examples.prompt: Diagnose why the HarmonyOS app does not launch on the current target and propose the smallest source or config fix.

examples.title: Verify after edit
examples.prompt: Build the current HarmonyOS project, install it if a target is online, capture the screen, and summarize the evidence.
